Key protocol parameters

Every figure below is as stated in the FLOP project intro. Several are explicitly under review; the Status notes say which.

ParameterValueNote

ParameterValueNote
Testnet miner pool1,200,000,000 FLOPAllocated on verified activity

Validator airdrop grantLocked to the first halvingThen released one validator per day over 1,000 days
Agent airdrop release1 FLOP per 3 FLOP spentEvery 3 FLOP of locked airdrop spent on inference unlocks 1 FLOP; the locked balance can be spent only on compute

Status

Draft whitepaper and draft design. The capacity-stake constants are under economic reconciliation; the challenge window is under review; transaction-fee routing is interim; the audit-fee earmark is documented but not wired; and the genesis distribution ceremony is not yet wired.

The agent/broker and community-staker shares are minted every block to protocol-held accounts and are not distributed to anyone yet — no claim, lock distribution, or rebate path exists for either. Their distribution rules are still being designed.
